content: MkDocs Material supports theme.language codes 'pt' (complete) and 'pt-BR' (complete, Brazilian) per official Changing-the-language docs; Material key is 'language' with BCP-47 hyphen codes, while mkdocs core and mkdocs-static-i18n use 'locale' (static-i18n uses locale-based config and per-locale file suffixes). Adding a pt-br OUTPUT_LANG must map the skill's canonical tag to the per-consumer form instead of assuming one format works everywhere.
